maddeler.e:
ننبري (form VII)
# نَنْبَرِي (nanbarī) /nan.ba.riː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَرَى (inbarā)
# نَنْبَرِيَ (nanbariya) /nan.ba.ri.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَرَى (inbarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
